description:
Core #2927 fixed scripts/publication/check_explorer_compat.py by putting the repo root on sys.path, but added no test. The existing tests import the module under pytest, where the root is already importable, so they passed throughout the incident that broke the bundle pipeline (core run 38294623553 and 38332679389). The fallback pin remains (now 16) and duplicates _project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/contract.py:4; tests/unit/scripts/publication/test_check_explorer_compat.py:50 hardcodes 16; the fallback warning is one stderr line that does not change the exit code; CLI_DESCRIPTION still names v13.

Smallest fix: import the contract directly with no fallback, and add one subprocess test that runs the script by path.
